content: The page defines the shadow of a figure as the lieux refining it, called the lieux de la figure, and warns not to confuse these with strata that are themselves lieux.

It describes the multiombre as formed from the shadows of the strata and indexed by the deployment tilde F, the set of strata of F. Inclusion in the associated set-theoretic figure is identified with incidence among strata, induced by ≤ in/de M, or equivalently by ≪ according to the author.

It says a figure is practically never reconstructed from its shadow but is nevertheless often reconstructed from its multiombre, in the case of Ateliers ensemblistes. It closes the paragraph with Nous y reviendrons and starts an unfinished discussion of canonical order relations.
math_reading_decisions: The ordinary F after strates de was inspected in crop 14 because its upper arm is looped. It has one stem and two arms; the top arm is retraced, not accompanied by a separate extra overbar or tilde. The two actual deployment occurrences have an additional clear wavy tilde.
The ≤ and ≪ signs are distinct and legible; no sign correction is made. M has the tall paired-peak form represented by the supplied table as mathcal M.
The final sign after ça revient au is barred cursive m, a verbal abbreviation, not an equality sign.
The plural/singular incidence(s), the two de/dans prepositions and the formé/formée ending are retained as ink uncertainties. No grammatical or mathematical normalization decides them.
The initial ré of the second réconstitue contains looping/retraced strokes but no independently readable canceled predecessor. No deletion was invented there.
The apparently canceled om and a are qualified at the physical-state level as well as the letter level. A dark or doubled initial alone does not establish an independent deletion.
The page presents assertions and definitions, without a derivation. Visual comparison is not recorded as a proof check.
author_doubts: No explicit authorial doubt or proof-check request is visible.
The author writes “(ou par ≪ au choix, ça revient au [barred m])”; this is an equivalence assertion, not a doubt mark.
“Nous y reviendrons.” is a promise to return to the issue, not a completed argument.
“Il y a lieu de parler des relations d’ordre canoniques” opens a discussion that continues beyond this page; no following page was consulted.
titles_dates_counts: Manuscript page number 6; assigned scan 7. No title, date, separate archive pencil number or marginal note was observed.
Two prose paragraphs, the second unfinished at the page end; no displayed formula, diagram or drawing. One phrase is singly underlined across two manuscript lines.

Four local correction regions are represented: initial multiombre, relation d’… inclusion, start of souvent, and à partir; a fifth possible correction is the initial A of Ateliers. The first and fifth correction states remain uncertain.
Fourteen actual enhanced crops were produced and viewed. All fourteen distinct C doubt loci are accounted for: five resolved and nine retained. S.json contains no rows.
